name: APEX MERIDIAN: Reflex Championship Series
description: The premier BCI reflex esport of the 2210s, APEX MERIDIAN pits eight-player teams in hyper-speed tactical combat simulations where reaction times are measured in microseconds and augmented players with military-grade BCIs compete against strict hardware handicap rules designed to maintain a 'pure neural' division. Sponsored by the corponation triad of Khoury-Massen Defense, Strukturen AG, and HelixCorp, the Championship Series fills the Meridian Grand Arena and streams to an estimated 40 million concurrent viewers. The game is as much fashion spectacle as sport — team chrome aesthetics are judged alongside match statistics.
story_hooks: A Shelf-born player qualifies for the pure neural division and begins receiving anonymous offers to throw matches — and threats when they refuse.
A journalist investigating the Calabar-Shen scandal discovers the banned mods were manufactured by one of the championship's own sponsors.
A former champion, now coaching, discovers that the hardware handicap algorithm has a backdoor that allows selective enforcement — and someone is using it to control outcomes.
